```pipeline
read data/LHD_FXX_0657_6868_PTS_O_LAMB93_IGN69.copc.laz --statistics
! sql "SELECT point_source_id AS line, floor((gps_time - t0) * 2) / 2 AS t, CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS n FROM input JOIN (SELECT point_source_id AS l, min(gps_time) AS t0 FROM input GROUP BY point_source_id) m ON input.point_source_id = m.l GROUP BY point_source_id, floor((gps_time - t0) * 2) / 2 ORDER BY line, t"
! chart line --x t:Q --y n:Q --color line:N
! zoom 0..13.5 100000..200000
```
